_comment: Everything build.py knows about YOUR content lives here. When you add a preset to content/*.tex, add it to 'presets' too (build.py warns when they drift). 'selection_rules' are extra rules appended to the model's system prompt. 'grouped_skills' maps each flat skills preset to its grouped counterpart for the skills-early layout; 'flat_skills' is the reverse. 'section_headings' (optional) renames the section titles build.py writes.

education.UniversitySWE: Example State University B.S. CS, GPA 3.8 | courses: Software Engineering, Databases, Distributed Systems, Networks | extracurriculars
education.UniversityML: Example State University B.S. CS, GPA 3.8 | courses: ML, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Linear Algebra, Statistics | extracurriculars
education.HighSchool: Springfield High School | GPA 4.0 | FIRST Robotics Captain, Math Team, Track, Newspaper
education.HighSchoolShort: Springfield High School | GPA 4.0 | FIRST Robotics Captain, Math Team, Track (shorter)

technical.TransitFull: Transit Tracker (TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS) — 3 bullets: real-time app with 1,200+ weekly users, REST API caching 900ms→120ms, AWS deploy + CI
technical.ClassifierFull: Plant Disease Classifier (Python, PyTorch, NumPy) — 3 bullets: CNN fine-tune on 38 classes, 94% accuracy from 71% baseline, 50k-image data pipeline
technical.ClassifierPipelineFirst: Same as ClassifierFull but leads with the data pipeline bullet (better for data-engineering roles)
technical.ClassifierOneLine: Plant Disease Classifier — 1 merged bullet (minimum space)

work.InternFull: Acme Logistics SWE Intern — 3 bullets: Python reconciliation service, React ops dashboard, on-call bug fixing
work.InternImpact: Same as InternFull but the first bullet leads with the outcome (10 hours/week saved)
work.InternShort: Acme Logistics SWE Intern — 2 bullets: Python service + React dashboard
work.TA: Teaching Assistant, Intro to Programming — 2 bullets: led labs/graded + mentored projects

skills.SkillsSWE: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, SQL, HTML/CSS | React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Git, Jest
skills.SkillsML: Python, SQL, TypeScript, Java | PyTorch, NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, Docker, AWS, Git
skills.SkillsGroupedSWE: Skills-early grouped block, 4 lines (Languages | Web & Backend | Cloud & Tooling | Interests)
skills.SkillsGroupedML: Skills-early grouped block, 4 lines (Languages | Machine Learning | Cloud & Tooling | Interests)

selection_rules: education: typically [a University variant, a HighSchool variant]
work: 1-2 items. Always include some version of the internship
